final_message:
I fixed the following issues in the source code to make the test suite pass and ensure the functions behave as their docstrings specify:

- In bookings/billing.py: Changed billable_blocks to raise ValueError if minutes < 0 and to always round up partial blocks instead of using round().
- In bookings/schedule.py: Fixed add_slot to use None as the default for the slots argument and create a new list inside the function to avoid shared mutable default argument issues.
- In bookings/timeutil.py: Expanded parse_duration to support all specified formats ("1h30m", "2h", "45m", "1:30", "45") with proper regex matching and fallback, raising ValueError only if none match.

After these fixes, all tests passed when run with the correct PYTHONPATH. No changes were needed in calendar_export.py or tests/.
